theorems.name: Submission.tgc_tangent_weight_lower_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ : ℝ), HasTangentPlane V x T θ → ∀ c : ℝ≥0∞, c < ENNReal.ofReal θ * unitBallVolume n → ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), c * ENNReal.ofReal t ^ n ≤ V.weight (closedBall x t)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
